description_zh: 面向 AI 智能体的人本设计技能，融合设计心理学与专业 UX 工程，支持产品、系统功能、界面、复杂工作流和人机协作设计，强化防错恢复、无障碍、用户控制权及可执行验收。
description_en: A human-centered design skill for AI agents, combining design psychology with UX engineering to improve products, interfaces, complex workflows and human–AI collaboration through error prevention, accessibility, user control and evidence-based verification.
